nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Facial Cleanser

avis.texte: First off, I love the citrus smell of the face wash. It did not irritate my skin. The beads exfoliated my skin really well and left it very smooth and glowing. I will definitely be purchasing a bottle after this one runs out. I recommend this 10/10. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been loving the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser! ✨ It gently exfoliates while leaving my skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed without feeling overly dry. I love that it helps give my skin a healthy-looking glow while still feeling moisturizing. Perfect for adding a little extra glow to my skincare routine! 💕✨

this stuff is amazing. i don't know how they do it but my skin looks so glowy after washing with this! i wish it wasn't a ohysically exfoliating because i would love to use it more often, but i can only do it 1-2x a week in combo w my tret. i was offered this for free for a review but i would buy again and would love to get this in a non exfoliating formula. i received this product in exchange for honest review.

avis.titre: Makes my skin so soft and glowy
avis.texte: I absolutely love this exfoliating wash. It made my skin super clean and left it feeling so soft and vibrant. My skin was glowing after every wash. Will be recommending and a new staple to my routine. I did receive this from Clinique for my honest review.

I tried this face wash on my sensitive combo skin. It has a gritty texture feel. My face feels a bit dry after I use the wash. I do seem to get more breakouts since I started using. My last wash was cream so this was quite a change. There isn't a scent which is nice. I don't think I'd buy it again, but it might work fine for some. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have used this product for a couple months now and have been loving it. My face feels so clean and soft after using. I love the exfoliation it give my skin. It has not caused me to break out or hurt my skin. I was sent this product to test and have been loving it

Loved being able to try out this cleanser! It's gentle, fragrance-free, doesn't make my face feel dry, and does a great job of helping me combat dry skin on my face. It turn into a soft lather and rinsed off beautiful. While I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes, my review is genuine. This is one of the better face scrubs I've used in a long time.

I've been using this in the morning and I really like it as a refreshing way to start the day. The little exfoliating beads feel good and leave my skin feeling really clean and smooth, but surprisingly not dry or tight afterward. My skin tends to be pretty dry, so I definitely notice when a cleanser strips it, and this one doesn't. I also really like the texture and just the overall feel of using it. Nothing life changing, but it's a solid cleanser and I've enjoyed using it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean, and hydrated. The exfoliation is gentle and leaves my skin feeling and looking smoother after using. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed using this cleanser. It feels gentle on my skin while still leaving it feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. I especially liked using it in the morning because it left my skin feeling smooth and looking brighter without feeling dry or tight afterward

I've really been enjoying this cleanser! It has a gentle exfoliating effect that leaves my skin feeling incredibly smooth, fresh, and clean without making it feel dry or tight. 🫧 After using it, my skin looks brighter and more refreshed, with a soft, healthy glow. I also love that it feels gentle enough for regular use while still helping to remove dull, dead skin cells. Perfect if you want that clean, smooth, glowing-skin feeling after cleansing. 💕 Definitely a product I would recommend! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser for over a month now and I really like it. I mostly use it in the morning, and it leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without feeling too dry. I like the texture and how my skin feels after using it. I have really enjoyed this cleanser and will definitely be buying it again. I would also recommend it to others. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this product for a while now, and don't have any complaints. It goes on smooth, and makes my face feel super refreshed after washing with this product. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I've been using the Clinique Moisure Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser for the past month or so and it will definitely remain in my nighttime routine! I have combination/oily skin that is also sensitive, so it's difficult to find physical exfoliation products that make my skin feel clean without feeling stripped and dry. This cleanser is gentle enough to use daily and I have noticed my skin is smoother and looks brighter. The bamboo beads give the perfect amount of grit without irritation. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I'm a big fan of Clinique and this cleanser did not disappoint. The tiny exfoliating beads feel great like they are thoroughly cleaning my skin. It smells clean and subtle, feels refreshing, and does the job great. Used at night before bed and had to also use a makeup remover but this cleanser felt more for skin care rather than strict makeup cleaning. Would try again. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I use this face wash about 3 times a week and it leaves my face feeling refreshed and clean each time. This is a gentle cleanser and i would definitely recommend this product to other people. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I love an exfoliator that doesn't leave my skin dry and strips all the moisture which is why I have been loving the cleanser from Clinique. It helps remove all dirt and keeps the skin clean. It is very gentle on skin and my skin feels moist after. It's been great for my night skincare routine. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Yes, it does make my skin glow. I was very impressed; and I'm hooked and will be using this for now on regularly. My skin on my face hasn't had it better in like forever. I haven't had any breakouts or any kind of troublesome problems since starting this cleanser. The price isn't bad reasonable and I will be purchasing this for now on instead of wasting my money on cleansers that don't do anything or irritate my skin. No irritation at all, not even from the first time use. I even use it everyday. My skin is so clean and smooth, and I haven't hardly wore any foundation at all since I started using this about a week after. I've been using this for over a month and I don't plan to change at all. I'm very happy with my current skin. And I have really oily skin and it has even toned that down a lot. My skin hasn't been this nice in forever. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Makes my skin soft and glowing
avis.texte: Absolutely, love.This stuff leaves my skin feeling so soft and glowing... so gentle on skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
Love this, especially after heavy sunscreen use on a beach day. Skin felt really clean, smooth, and not dried out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I am enjoying using this Clinique exfoliating cleanser! It does a good job of exfoliating my skin and removing dry patches while washing away the grease and dirt from the day. The formula is still hydrating and foams up nicely upon application. The smell is also good! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have been using the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser for over a month now and I really like it. I mostly use it in the morning, and it leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without feeling too dry. I like the texture and how my skin feels after using it. I have really enjoyed this cleanser and will definitely be buying it again. I would also recommend it to others. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

It's hard to find an exfoliator that doesn't leave my skin dry and irritated afterwards but the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser leaves my skin feeling and looking hydrated and glowy afterwards! It cleanses well and gets rid of dead skin and is gentle enough for daily use. I only use it a few times a week but if I needed it I could use it more often as well! I received this product free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I'm a Clinique girly through and through 💚, so I really wanted to love the Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Facial Cleanser. Unfortunately, it just doesn't do it for me. It's simply not as good as the original 2-in-1 Jelly, and nothing compares! Clinique, please bring back the 2-in-1 Jelly! 🙏🏽 It was one of those products I genuinely loved and would happily repurchase. I've been loyal to Clinique for years, and I truly believe in the brand, but the Moisture Surge cleanser just isn't giving what the 2-in-1 Jelly gave. Clinique girl forever, but please give us our Jelly back! 💚✨

I absolutely love this Exfoliating Cleanser! I find it to be very gentle and non-irritating for my dry and sensitive skin. I first wash my face with the All About Face gentle face wash and follow it with the exfoliating cleanser. I love how my skin looks and feels! I put just a dollop of the exfoliating cleanser in my palm and add some water and rub my hands together to create a lather and then I gently scrub my face avoiding the eye area. I also take the scrub down to neck and chest area. For years I used Clinique (since I was 13 until I was 32), then I started using other of the moment brands, which either continually discontinued or drastically changed their products. I finally made the decision at age 69 to return to Clinique and I am so glad that I have! I am so enjoying all my new products and have a very long wish list of items to purchase.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I would absolutely recommend this product, I tend to have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate nor cause me to have a breakout, my skin is left so soft and glowing afterwards.

I've really been enjoying the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean, smooth, and refreshed without that tight, dried-out feeling some exfoliating cleansers can leave behind. My skin feels softer after using it, and I love the healthy glow it gives me. It's gentle enough to use regularly while still making my skin feel like it's getting a good exfoliation. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine! I received this product for free from Clinique for test and review purposes.

avis.titre: My opinionClinique Moisture Surge™ Exfoliating Glow Cleanser
avis.texte: I've really been enjoying the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser! It gently exfoliates while cleansing, leaving my skin feeling smooth, refreshed, and noticeably more radiant without that tight, stripped feeling some exfoliating cleansers can cause. I love that my skin feels soft and clean after using it, and it gives my complexion a healthy-looking glow. It's a great addition to my skincare routine when I want gentle exfoliation and hydration in one step. Definitely a cleanser I would recommend to anyone looking for smoother, glowier-looking skin! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
Was very gentle on my skin without causing any irritation to my skin. Left my face feeling soft and clean and perfect for the base of my skincare routine.

This Exfoliating cleanser is amazing it is gentle on my sensitive skin not harsh and crates a soft foam that cleanses deeply and helps remove any impurities and excess oil, plus leaves my skin soft and ready for my next skincare products

I'm really impressed with the Clinique Moisture Glow Exfoliating Cleanser! The texture is perfect—it provides noticeable exfoliation while still feeling gentle and comfortable on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling smooth, rejuvenated, and fresh without that tight, stripped feeling some exfoliating cleansers can cause. My skin feels softer and looks brighter after using it, and I love that it gives me gentle exfoliation while still leaving my skin feeling moisturized. It has a luxurious feel and leaves my skin looking refreshed and glowing. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
Left my skin nice and soft. Really like this product. In the past I have used 7 Day Scrub Cream, I like both of these products.
I didn't think Exfoliating cleanser would work. My skin is soft clear moisturizer, soft hydrate.. I will definitely be purchasing this cleanser again... I also received it Free thanks TopCircle. ❤️

I truly loved using this exfoliating cleanser from Clinique. Their Moisture Surge line of products have long been a favorite in my household for their ability to hydrate without causing skin issues. This product is no different. Made with aloe bioferment, hyaluronic acid, and finely milled bamboo beads, this cleanser allows you to gently slough off dead skin without harming your skin's natural barrier and providing moisture and hydration. I saw some reviewers mention they were concerned about the "grit" in this, however, when bamboo is finely milled (as this is) the beads are uniform in size which means they will NOT scratch your skin. This is safe for daily usage and if you have sensitive skin from combination to oily, this product is for you. The scent is minimal and leans to a spa like scent (not floral or fruity) in case you have scent/perfume sensitivities. With it being summer, I like to exfoliate to keep my skin happy and healthy looking and this product worked beautifully. Plus, it froths up making your skin feel clean while bringing out your natural glow. I highly recommend! *I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this face wash for the past two weeks, and I've been very impressed with the results. I've received several compliments on how smooth and healthy my skin looks. It also leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and silky. Overall, I highly recommend this face wash and would give it a 10/10. I plan to continue using it as part of my skincare routine. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have oily, non-sensitive skin and I'm not acne-prone, but I do deal with clogged pores and dark spots. I typically prefer chemical exfoliants because physical exfoliation can sometimes be a little too much for my skin. That said, I enjoyed this cleanser! The scrub particles are very fine and gentle, and I had no issues with irritation. I personally used it a couple times a week rather than daily. I'm not sure I'd repurchase, but I would recommend it if you're looking for a gentle 2-in-1 cleanser and exfoliant. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
This grapefruit smelling gentle exfoliater works so good. The packaging is great for everyone. So easy to use.

avis.titre: Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser Review
avis.texte: I've been loving the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser! 🫶 I use it day and night on certain days, one day I'll use it during the day, and another day I'll use it at night. I absolutely love the texture, and I've noticed that my skin looks brighter and feels smoother since using it. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean without any complaints. Definitely 5 stars from me! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using Clinique's Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser every morning for about two weeks. It is unscented and has a slightly gritty texture from the bamboo beads, which surprisingly feel amazing as they're being massaged into your skin. So far, I haven't noticed any makeup left behind after using it, and I haven't experienced any skin irritation or other issues. Overall, it has been gentle on my skin and does what I need it to do. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

[ I got free product from Clinique for exchange my honest review ] I've really been enjoying this cleanser lately. It feels nice and refreshing when I use it, and I like how my skin feels smoother and cleaner after rinsing. The exfoliating part is gentle enough for me when I don't want to use a separate scrub. My skin feels fresh afterward without that overly tight, dry feeling. I also like that there's no strong fragrance, which makes the whole experience more pleasant. Overall, it's become a nice addition to my routine, especially when my skin is looking a little dull and I want it to feel fresh and polished. 💕

For the past three and a half weeks I have been using Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser each night. I dispense a nickel-sized amount onto my textured facial washcloth, add warm water, work into a lather, then gently wash and rinse my entire face. It has not been overly drying but leaves my skin feeling clean and balanced. I can definitely feel the texture of the silica and the exfoliating bamboo beads, but the exfoliation is gentle and does not irritate my skin. I love that there are no oils, no parabens, no pthalhates, and no drying alcohols. The hyaluronic acid causes the skin to attract moisture. My skin is less dull and is softer. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have combo skin, not sensitive at all. I've used plenty of exfoliating products in the past, but this didn't match up to them. It felt too abrasive on my skin, and did not do anything for it. However, I have given it to others to try. I'm not sure of their skin condition but they have told me they liked it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this exfoliating cleanser. It is moisturizing and does not strip the skin barrier like most exfoliating cleansers. There are plenty of beads in this cleanser so you do get a good exfoliation. It is actually great for sensitive skin. I have very sensitive skin and it is helping me clear it up. I been dealing with dermatitis and this has helped tremendously. It does give moisture back into the skin. Also it's gentle enough for everyday use. I would definitely recommend it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Not Too Harsh for My Skin Barrier
avis.texte: I really like this cleanser as a once-a-week reset for my skin. The bamboo beads provide enough physical exfoliation that my skin feels noticeably smoother and refreshed afterward, but it doesn't feel overly abrasive or leave my skin stripped and dry. Since I'm careful about protecting my skin barrier, I don't use physical exfoliants every day, but this fits perfectly into my routine when I feel like my skin needs a little extra help removing buildup and texture. I appreciate that I can get that satisfying freshly exfoliated feeling without feeling like I've been too aggressive with my skin. Once a week has been the sweet spot for me, and I look forward to using it.

I've been using this cleanser at night. It's great at removing make-up, and my skin feels smoother. I definitely recommend this product. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I have been using it off and on for about two weeks now and have noticed smooth skin great for making a blank canvas for a nighttime routine. It is a very good exfoliating cleanser.

Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser is amazing! I love the consistency, it smells nice, and it leaves my skin feeling super clean and hydrated. Definitely recommend! *I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I am enjoying this moisture surge exfoliating cleanser. I really like how it gently exfoliate and clean my pores with out stripping my combination skin. It leaves my skin a bit moisturize but I do follow up with the rest of my skin regimen. I will continue using this and see how soft and glowy my skins gets. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Ladies..let your inner glow show! This product will have you beaming..I use it every morning to aliven my skin and start the day off right. It feels amazing with a light exfoliating scrub thats just perfect and not to abrasive. It has a light clean scent that awakens the senses and preps your skin beautifully for any lotion or make up you may choose to apply. I have noticed a difference in texture hydration and overall appearance of my mature skin and I LOVE IT! Its never looked so healthy. I recommend this product 100 percent! Its not only changed the way I see myself but the way others see me as well..because several have commented on the change in my appearance. A HUGE thank you to Clinique for this free product I received for free for testing and review purposes. Youve gained a fan and new customer!

This is a wonderful product to use. It feels good on my skin and is lightweight. The exfoliation in this product is minimal. The scent is not strong and smells nice. It leaves my skin feeling good. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Makes my skin incredibly smooth and hydrated
avis.texte: Wow this cleanser is incredible. It's gentle enough for daily use. It makes my face feel so soft, smooth, hydrating and clean without it feeling stripped. I can't believe how little product you need it lathers so well with the smallest amount. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

One of the best exfoliating cleanser ever. It removes impurities without stripping my skin. I've been using it for a few days and can already see a nice glow. Definitely a great addition to my routine!

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes but I would buy it again. I've used it on everything from my face to my feet and it made a difference. It wasn't drying on my face although it felt a bit rough but that's true of many exfoliants. It was great on my feet because I've been walking around outside without shoes on a lot during the summer which makes my feet dry and cracked. I've used this as an exfoliant to help and it does the job!

This gentle exfoliating glow cleanser did not disappoint. I am in my middle 40's and I have to be careful when I use exfoliating cleansers because they can dry my skin out, and leave my skin feeling tight. This one did not dry my skin out at all. I even used it daily because it was so gentle. I did use it at night because my face tends to turn red when I use an exfoliator. I love that the exfoliating beads were very fine. When I used it my face felt very clean, rejuvenated, and brighter. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This has been a great exfoliating cleanser for my dry, acne-prone skin. I use it every other or every three nights since my skin is sensitive and I don't want to over-exfoliate. There is no fragrance which works great for me. The gel texture is lightweight with fine bamboo beads for exfoliating. It glides on easily and has seamlessly fit into my night time routine to make my skin glow. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

You can use this cleanser every day. It cleanses the skin thoroughly without leaving a greasy residue. It provides deep hydration and feels lightweight. It is suitable for combination skin and can be used before applying makeup. It is an excellent, lightweight, oil-free moisturizing gel-cream. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Clinique's Moisture Surge Exfoliating Cleanser is a great addition to my skincare routine. I tend to double cleanse, first with an oil cleanser, then with a water based one. This fulfills the second step of my cleansing routine well. I love that it is scentless and the added aloe and acids make it so it isn't stripping. My face doesn't get dry or gain a residue. The exfoliating beads are plentiful in this, there are a lot of them and they're very small. It feels very light however when you lather it before applying. Since the beads are bamboo, it should be eco-friendly, which is a plus. All in all, this cleanser performs in all aspects if you want an easy to use, gentle cleanser that leaves your face fresher than before. I would say it's a pretty standard and worth it for your routine. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Gentle Cleanser for Smooth, Glowing Skin
avis.texte: I really love this cleanser! The lightweight gel turns into a soft foam that leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without feeling dry or tight. The fine bamboo beads gently exfoliate away dead skin cells, leaving my skin noticeably smoother and more radiant. It's gentle enough for everyday use and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I got this exfoliating cleanser a few weeks ago. I have eczema so I was worried to try it but decided to give it a go. I used it every 4-5 days and so far no flare ups. It is a creamy texture with the bamboo beads. I do have to make sure I moisturize more when exfoliating my skin. The cleanser left my skin feeling soft and glowy. I highly recommend trying this exfoliating cleanser.

I have normal to dry skin and this right here has helped with any possible dry patches I get. The gentle exfoliation plus a fresh almost juicy hydrated like quality of the cleaner itself has been amazing to use. Scent wise is zero to very faint so perfect for people sensitive to smells. The exfoliating bits are enough to scrub and gently exfoliate but not enough to be like a heavy physical exfoliant or a cleansing microdermabrasion product. I find myself using this almost daily (I use a chemical exfoliant as well once a week and try not to use physical the of or prior).

avis.titre: Gentle Cleanser Perfect for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser every night and I love how refreshing it is. I have combination skin with dryness mainly on my forehead. This exfoliating cleanser makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. I'm usually not the biggest fan of cleansers with the little exfoliating beads in it, but it was gentle on my sensitive skin. I also really enjoy the fact that it is fragrance free and the smell isn't overwhelming at all. I I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I've been enjoying the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser for my 40+ skin. It gently exfoliates with fine bamboo beads while cleansing away impurities without leaving my skin feeling stripped. I especially love the addition of hyaluronic acid and aloe bioferment-my skin feels soft, refreshed, and noticeably smoother with a healthy glow after cleansing. A lovely option when mature skin needs gentle exfoliation without sacrificing hydration. ✨

This product feels really nice on the skin and removes all my makeup. Its leaves my skin feeling really fresh and clean without it being stripping. Its a good staple to have around! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and reviews.

avis.titre: the way to get soft skin
avis.texte: I used this cleanser both in the morning and at night. As someone who is sensitive to fragrances, I appreciate that this product is truly fragrance-free and does not smell like anything. I can feel the exfoliating beads when I put it on my face, but they are very fine. The cleanser dispenses as a gel but it lathers up very easily. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and smooth. I am very satisfied with this product. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser goes from a gel to a foam. It left my skin feeling clean and smooth. It lightly exfoliated but it didn't feel overly abrasive. Overall I really enjoy this cleanser. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser is really good for sensitive skin. I have been using it consistently and feel like the beads within the formula really help to exfoliate and make my skin feel fresh afterwards as well as hydrated. Will continue to be using this product as I love it and enjoy the way it feels on my face. No drying and no irritation. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product free from topbox circle in exchange for my honest review. I was very excited to try this product and it did not disappoint. Clinique is definitely a brand favorite for me! This cleanser has small bamboo beads fir exfoliation. Also contains glycerin and hyloronic acid for hydration. Gel like texture and makes my face feel smooth and soft. I used it everyday with no issue. I would definitely recommend especially if you have dry skin.

The Clinique moisture surge exfoliating cleanser was very gentle on my skin. I used it in the evening, several times a week. It cleaned and exfoliated without feeling abrasive. My face was left feeling very moisturized after using the product. I appreciated that it did not have a strong scent. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoy using this Clinique moisture surge exfoliating glow cleanser. The bamboo beads feel nice on my skin without being irritating. It almost feels like a sugar scrub like a finer sandy texture, it's nice. I received this product for free from Clinic for testing purposes.

i love this product! has been great at exfoliating all of the summer gunk off of my face. i appreciate the actual exfoliants in this product- i feel so much cleaner! i've noticed less breakouts since using this cleanser. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This product makes my skin feel brand new! So soft. I always get a little nervous with exfoliating products but this one is gentle and provides good moisture. I use it every night and have noticed a visible difference in my skin. Pores feel and appear cleaner and having less breakouts! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This has been such a nice change of pace for my skin. I am combination skin so some days I run more dry/oily. I usually don't like exfoliating cleansers for everyday use but I have been enjoying this one. It has super light beads that always leave my face feeling moisturized after I'm done. It has a fairly light scent, not too overpowering. I would definitely try more of this line in the future to see how it works with the other products. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I docked a star by virtue of it being a physical exfoliant; I have never loved the experience of grinding tiny bits into my face. That being said, this is the gentlest, least irritating physical exfoliant I have used by far. It smells nice and it doesn't HURT to use or feel like it's cutting up my face; there is still a grindy sensation but it's much more bearable than other physical exfoliants. I felt exceptionally fresh and clean after using it and it didn't break me out or irritate my skin after using it a few mornings in a row. I have very dry skin and my skin did not feel stripped or dehydrated after use. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I've been using this product as part of my morning skincare routine, and I love how fresh my skin feels afterward. It has gentle exfoliating particles that help remove buildup without feeling too harsh. My skin feels clean, soft, and smoother after using it. I also like that it leaves my skin looking more refreshed and glowing without making it feel overly dry or tight. Overall, it's been a nice addition to my routine. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
Super gentle and fragrance free. Lathers very nicely and does not leave any residue on the skin without stripping it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I am LOVING this cleanser!!!! It makes my skin buttery soft and has gotten rid of all my blackheads. I used to use MK timewise and could never find a good replacement but this one is IT, I will continue to purchase. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I used this product in the mornings and at nights. This product works well on sensitive and combination skin. It smells good and it left my skin feeling smooth, refreshed, and glowing. This is an amazing product.

I love this exfoliating cleanser. I have sensitive skin and this was sensitive enough to not cause issues for me. I have combo skin and it helps with excess oil and acne for sure. I received this product free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is a very nice exfoliant that I enjoy using at the end of the day while in the shower. I use it on my neck and my face and I find it to be very gentle while also being effective. Unfortunately I do think that the exfoliating beads are a little clingy and they can be hard to completely rinse off especially if I get too many in my eyebrows. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

A gentle exfoliating cleanser that cleanses my skin without drying it out or irritating it. Helped clear up my breaks from a previous cleanser that I was using. Removes all of my makeup at the end of the day. Leaves my skin glowing and refreshed. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Very effective cleanser for larger pores
avis.texte: I have been using this Clinique Moisture surge gel to foam cleanser for several weeks now and i am very pleased with how effective it is at clearing any and all substance in my nose pores. I have tried many cleansers that tend to be abrasive and totally ineffective at cleaning larger pores. The bamboo beads are very effective by being small and pleasantly gentle! This cleanser has become a favorite go to for gentle and very effective pore cleanser. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: I feel like a glowing goddess
avis.texte: I use this scrub in the morning because I want to make sure that I'm exfoliated and literally glowing for the rest of the day. I feel like it helps scrub off any dead skin and impurities while still leaving my skin feeling soft and moisturized. On days when I don't want to wear makeup but look like a glowing queen this is my go to. I suggest this exfoliating scrub. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes and loved it! Refreshingly clean skin, gently takes away waterproof makeup and sunscreen, highly recommend!!

This exfoliating cleanser leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. It gently removes dead skin and buildup without feeling harsh. My skin looks brighter and more refreshed after cleansing. The texture feels soft and clean without drying out my skin.

This product is very moisturizing but because I have sensitive skin on my face in certain areas it did feel a bit harsh. But overall it's an okay product to try out!! Especially for combination skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Amazing cleanser. Use in the mornings and noticed my face instantly brightens up after using. The beads are gentle but still provides exfoliating power. This will now be a staple in my skincare routine.
I thoroughly enjoyed this product and when I scan feeling nice and clean with all gritty feeling. Add a nicely sent to it as well. I look forward to buying this product again in the future.
This cleaners is so refreshing to my skin, gentle cleanse but a powerful result. I recommend this to everyone. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This is an amazing product.clinique never disappoints me. This is lightweight gelish texture but turns into a soft smoothing foam wash that takes all the dirt and nasty stuff off your face without drying it out to make your skin literally glow and feel so amazing. Its easy to apply and wash off I prefer using it in the morning before I get ready to do my routine for work because it wakes me up and puts me in a good mood feeling all clean and great bc the first thing everyone sees is your face. I would buy this over and over again and recommend this to any and everyone! You can use it no matter what skin type you have. Its definitely a hidden gem among the clinique products. A must have. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I have pretty dry skin, so | was initially nervous that this product would make my skin even drier. But as l've been using the cleanser at night about once to twice a week, l've really enjoyed adding it into my skincare routine and have noticed my skin is a lot smoother! I love that I can feel it gently exfoliating my skin without it feeling too abrasive or irritating. My skin feels refreshed after using it, but it still feels comfortable and moisturized rather than stripped.
I love it I used it every night before bed I loved the texture of it and how amazing it makes your face look and feel. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I enjoyed testing this cleanser because it was extremely gentle and didn't dry my skin out. It exfoliated wiithout making my skin feel stripped. It is pleasantly scented as well. I received this product from clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really am enjoying this product so far. I have combination and eczema prone skin and the fact that this is fragrance free is super beneficial to my skin. I have other moisture surge products from Clinique and this is a good addition to the line. I don't typically gravitate toward physical exfoliants, but the product is gentle and really makes me feel like it is cleaning my skin without stripping it.

I absolutely love Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly smooth, fresh, and hydrated without making it feel dry or stripped. I love the healthy-looking glow it gives my skin, and my face feels softer and more refreshed after using it. It's become such a nice addition to my skincare routine, especially when my skin is looking a little dull. Definitely a product I would recommend! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I think this is a great product it just doesn't work for me in my routine because of the salicylic acid. I use other actives at night so I don't want my face wash to include any. However, I do think this is a great product for someone who wants to exfoliate and simplify their routine - or for me when I'm feeling too lazy to do my full skincare routine. I have dry skin and this didn't dry out my skin so I do think it's good for dry, normal, and combo skin. It was unscented so I think it would also be good for someone with sensitivity to fragrance. It didn't break me out either. I was worried about the physical exfoliant but I didn't have any stinging when applying my skincare after that I would expect if I had any scrapes on my face. I think this will be good for me to try out in the winter to help exfoliate some of the dry patches. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I was honestly thrilled about using this product. It's really difficult to find an exfoliating face cleanser that's not too harsh on the skin, but still has good grit. This product is fantastic. I often have a hard time with facial cleansers almost all of them break me out or dry me out this one did absolutely neither of the two. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This scrub makes my skin SO smooth and soft. I typically exfoliate with a cloth in the shower, but I like being able to have a scrub gentle enough to use multiple times a week without damage. avis.titre: Left my skin soft, smooth and glowing!

Perfect for everyday use Totally recommend for sensitive skin Leaves skin soo soft and squeaky clean

I'm a product junkie, so when I first got the opportunity to test out the Clinique Moisture Surge Gentle Exfoliating Glow Face Cleanser, I was excited. I've used other scrubs in the past, but this one takes the cake. It's not too abrasive, and it doesn't scratch up your skin like shell scrubs can do. I've used this scrub daily for about a month now and definitely see a difference. For context, my face is usually dull, combination skin with some signs of aging (I'm newly 40), and large pores. Since using this scrub, I've noticed that not only has my skin texture improved, it also is brighter. After use, my skin doesn't feel tight, and I've noticed it has helped reduce the shiny forehead syndrome that I often end up with after a few hours. 10/10 would absolutely recommend! (Note: I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.)

I used this cleanser in the morning and it made my skin feel clean and smooth. I have sensitive, combination skin so it is difficult to find a cleanser that works for me. avis.titre: Makes my skin feel refreshed and glowy

avis.titre: Best exfoliating cleanser for dry skin!
avis.texte: I typically have very dry skin, so I am sometimes nervous to try exfoliating cleansers as they usually leave my skin feeling very dry. I used this cleanser at night after swimming when my face felt like it needed a really good clean. My face was left feeling surprisingly moisturized. I also struggle with blackheads and I love that this cleanser has small tactile beads of bamboo, which really feel like they are helping to remove the dirt from my pores. This cleanser also has a very pleasant and fresh scent. It is also allergy tested and fragrance free! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Clean, smooth, and glowing! Loving this Clinique cleanser.
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser. I used it in the morning and loved how fresh and smooth my skin felt afterward. The texture was gentle but still gave my skin a nice exfoliating feel, and it left my skin looking brighter without feeling overly dry or tight. Overall, it's a refreshing cleanser that I would happily continue using. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed testing the Clinique Moisture Surge™ Exfoliating Glow Cleanser. The cleanser feels gentle on my skin while leaving my face feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. I like the light exfoliating feel because it helps smooth my skin without making it feel overly dry. After rinsing, my skin feels fresh and looks brighter with a nice healthy glow. I also love that it is fragrance-free. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Makes My skin feel like i got a facial

avis.titre: So good on my combo skin!

Amazing!

avis.titre: Face feels Smooth, Clean and Fresh
avis.texte: I really enjoyed trying Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser. It has that tiny bit of grit that gives a nice exfoliation without feeling too harsh. My skin felt smooth, clean and fresh afterward, but not tight or overly dry. Definitely left my face feeling soft and glowy! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes, but I am writing this review as though I spent my own money on it. I have combination skin. It can be a pain finding the right products for me. Many address either the dryness or the oiliness, but it's a whole song and dance balancing the two. I was a little concerned adding this Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser to my routine, because they tend to tighten my cheeks in an uncomfortable way, but I had good results with this. I've been using it regularly for about a month, 1-2 times per week. I'm pleased to report that I actually really like this product. I used to use a moisturizer that did this job, but it was recently reformulated and no longer works for me. I am stoked that this is helping and works nicely along the other products I use. No red or flaky skin, no pain, no oily patches. I recommend giving this a shot if you need an exfoliator for combination skin.

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. I really love this cleanser! It's very creamy and smooth – a gentle exfoliating cleanser that doesn't feel harsh on my skin. I love its smell – it's light and pleasant. After using it, my skin feels so good and looks soft and smooth. It removes impurities without stripping my skin. I've been using it for a few days and can already see a nice glow. Definitely a great addition to my routine!

I have been using the Clinique Moisture Surge Exfoliating Glow Cleanser as part of my daily routine, and it has been a fantastic addition. The formula combines a lightweight gel texture with very fine bamboo beads that offer a gentle physical exfoliation. It foams up nicely, lifts away excess oil and surface impurities, and rinses off cleanly. Unlike many exfoliating cleansers that can leave the skin feeling stripped or dry, this cleanser leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated. I love that it is completely fragrance-free and gentle enough for daily use without causing redness or irritation. It leaves my complexion looking refreshed and visibly radiant. Only Con i can mention is not to use over active acne inflamed skin Highly recommend if you are looking to smooth out skin texture while keeping your moisture barrier intact.

I was actually out of town when it arrived, so my teenage daughter opened it and decided to try it before I even got home. She was really impressed with it. She said it did a great job getting rid of her blackheads and left her skin feeling super soft. The packaging is really nice. The bottle has that classic Clinique look and feels like a quality product. I also really liked the texture of the cleanser. It's creamy and soft, with a very fine bamboo grit. I was expecting the exfoliating part to feel a little rough, but it really doesn't. The grit is very gentle and doesn't feel like you're scrubbing your face with something harsh. One thing I really appreciated is that it doesn't have a perfume smell. I'm not a huge fan of scented facial products, so this was a big plus for me! When I first put it on my face, I was a little worried that it was going to leave some kind of film or greasy feeling behind because of how creamy it is. But once I rinsed it off, I was pleasantly surprised. It didn't leave a film at all. My skin felt clean, soft, and hydrated. Overall, both my daughter and I really enjoy using this cleanser and have already Incorporated it into our evening routine! I received it this product from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I'm really impressed with this cleanser! It has a creamy, gentle exfoliating feel that leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean, smooth, and refreshed without that tight, stripped feeling. The fine bamboo beads help buff away dull, dry skin, while hyaluronic acid and aloe help keep skin feeling hydrated. It also contains salicylic acid, which is a nice bonus for helping refine the look of pores and improve overall texture. After using it, my skin looks noticeably brighter and has that fresh, healthy glow I'm always looking for. I especially love that it's fragrance-free. I used this product each morning. This is A great choice if your skin is looking dull or uneven and you want a little exfoliation built right into your cleansing routine. My skin feels softer, smoother, and more radiant after every use! I received this free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I like this cleanser. I like that it exfoliates and cleanses. It makes my face feel clean without stripping it and giving me that tight uncomfortable feeling. The only thing I wish was different is that the little particles dissolved better.
